rebuttal_or_critique: I must strongly disagree with the proposal to shift to a neutral stance. While core inflation has moderated to 3.60%, the headline CPI at 5.10% remains significantly above our 4.00% target. The persistence of food inflation at 8.30% is a clear signal that supply-side shocks continue to threaten the durability of disinflation. With a positive output gap of 0.50% and GVA growth at 6.80%, the economy is operating above its potential, which risks unanchoring inflation expectations if we signal premature easing. A shift to neutral at this juncture would be inconsistent with our mandate to ensure that inflation aligns durably with the target. We must maintain the withdrawal of accommodation to ensure that liquidity conditions remain consistent with the objective of price stability.
